The transcription opens with "energetic plunging she broke her way through and climbed out" and ends with "so as to avoid the bad places". The leaf also has the captions "THE CHIEF'S HUT, AND GROUP OF GOONENNAR NATIVES" and "CHILKAT GRAVEYARD, SHOWING HOUSE OF FROG NATION."

The heading 'Capitulum. xi.' and the closing words 'Proinde illa omnia quae patribus visa sunt cum deus illis secundum suam dispensationem temporibus' are at the bottom of the right column on p44.

The transcription opens with 'תוספתא יומא פרק ראשון' and 'פרק א א למה מפרישין כהן גדול מביתו ללשכת (א) פלהדרין'.
